feature.imageCompressor.title: Image compression
feature.imageCompressor.description: Compress document images to WebP and optionally process uploads for authorized documents

allowlist.note: Grant access from the document title or document tree menu. You can also enter a rootID manually.

auto.title: Automatic compression
auto.description: When global is on, compress new images in all documents; otherwise only the local page list applies (SiYuan 3.8.4+).
auto.unsupported: This SiYuan version is below 3.8.4 and has no pre-upload event, so this option is unavailable.
compression.title: Compression settings

menu.compressDocument: Compress all images in this document

menu.resolveFailed: Cannot identify this document; authorization was not changed.

menu.grantGlobalOff: Authorize this document (global compression is off)
menu.disablePage: Disable automatic image compression for this document
menu.enablePage: Enable automatic image compression for this document
menu.granted: Automatic image compression authorized for this document.
